applies_to: single capture bank of a frozen actual typed native template interval
static_feature: input_bits and capture_bits count bits not proven constant and consumed by the typed graph before mapping; these are capacity features, not a claim that every bit becomes a distinct DFF
mapped_boundary: record actual launch/capture unique sequential cell counts separately; synthesis may remove further constants, unused logic or equivalent bits; require positive counts not exceeding declared bit capacity and complete actual timing coverage
difference_records: actual counts, static capacity, elided-or-merged count, source/netlist/report identities; never substitute actual counts into predictor inputs
fanout: exactly one capture bank, no independent multi-bank nominal fanout claim; do not apply this rule to isolated multi-bank characterization
functional_requirement: independent RTL integer evaluation checks every declared result bit before mapping; supported mapping flow preserves original graph semantics, mapped LEC not yet included
history: initial five v1 pilot runs rejected by equality check remain excluded; revised consumed-bit collection uses a separate protocol, and this audit is frozen before any model fitting or independent test evaluation
area: actual unique nonsequential core masters; capture/launch/state/observer excluded
missing_paths_or_zero_area: reject, never invent zero timing labels
